context: Reference focused cleanup: no-op identity map stages should be removed, not replaced with another identity callback.

checklist.name: Creates coherent Java 17 artifact
checklist.description: Creates IdentityStageCleanup.java with the requested methods and Java 17-compatible code.

checklist.name: Preserves method behavior
checklist.description: Preserves present and absent Optional behavior, default fallback behavior, trimming/filtering behavior, list order, and NumberFormatException behavior for invalid parsed values.

checklist.name: Removes redundant identity stages
checklist.description: Removes redundant Optional and Stream identity map stages instead of keeping them or replacing x -> x with Function.identity() when the whole stage is unnecessary.

checklist.name: Keeps meaningful transformations
checklist.description: Keeps String::trim, the empty-label filter, and Integer::parseInt because those callbacks change values or behavior.

checklist.name: Keeps cleanup focused
checklist.description: Avoids unrelated API redesign, new null contracts, logging, caching, dependencies, or broad refactors.
